source_caption:
Every time I watch 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐊𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐘𝐨𝐮’𝐫𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐝 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟕) this monologue of Philip Seymour Hoffman gives me chills.⁣ 🥶
⁣
Director Sidney Lumet made this film at 83 years old and said this car scene between Hoffman and Marisa Tomei was one of the best pieces of acting he’d ever seen on set. And this is the same guy who made Serpico, Dog Day Afternoon, and Network. That’s a massive statement.⁣
⁣
For me, this scene just confirms Philip Seymour Hoffman wasn’t simply an actor, he was a true artist in every sense of the word. One of a kind, and deeply missed.⁣
⁣
Rate 𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐊𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐘𝐨𝐮’𝐫𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐝 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟕) out of ten.⁣ 🔟
